title: Eluna: An Agentic LLM System for Automating Warehouse Operations with Reasoning and Task Execution
abstract: arXiv:2607.08960v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Warehouse operations are governed by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that encode complex, multi-system decision logic, which must be executed reliably under strict time constraints, yet LLM agents lack mechanisms to enforce procedural compliance and degrade under the context overload full SOP specifications introduce. We present Eluna, a production-deployed agentic system for reliable SOP execution. Eluna is a graph-guided, multi-agent framework that encodes SOPs as directed acyclic graphs with progressive disclosure and delegates independent tasks to parallel sub-agents, each with persistent code execution and live data access. translated_title: Eluna：一个用于自动化仓库操作并具备推理与任务执行的智能体LLM系统
translated_abstract: 仓库操作由标准操作程序（SOP）管理，这些程序编码了复杂的多系统决策逻辑，必须在严格的时间限制下可靠执行，然而LLM智能体缺乏强制程序合规的机制，并且在完整SOP规范带来的上下文过载下性能下降。我们提出了Eluna，一个用于可靠SOP执行的生产级智能体系统。Eluna是一个图引导的多智能体框架，将SOP编码为具有渐进式披露的有向无环图，并将独立任务委托给并行子智能体，每个子智能体具有持久代码执行和实时数据访问能力。为了满足生产环境的延迟和准确性需求，我们使用不对称情节蒸馏，其中强教师模型通过情节错误记忆进行改进，然后较小的学生模型在去除记忆的修正轨迹上进行微调，在无推理开销的情况下内化修正。
tldr: Eluna通过图引导的多智能体框架和不对称情节蒸馏，实现了仓库SOP的可靠自动化执行，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升了合规性和性能。
en_tdlr: Eluna achieves reliable warehouse SOP automation through a graph-guided multi-agent framework and asymmetric episodic distillation, improving compliance and performance without inference-time overhead.
